name: Git
purpose: Inspect repository changes and commit history

capabilities.name: git
capabilities.description: Selected inspection commands for Git repositories. Mutation status is unknown: status refreshes and writes the index by default, while log accepts --output to write a file. This is a partial community schema, not a CLI Spec conformance claim.

global_args.name: --no-optional-locks
global_args.description: Disable optional operations that require locks; use for status inspection.

global_args.name: --no-pager
global_args.description: Write straight to stdout instead of a pager; use for unattended reads.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Inspect staged, unstaged, and untracked changes. Use --no-optional-locks to avoid the optional index refresh.

args.name: --porcelain
args.description: Stable machine-readable text output.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Porcelain status records, not JSON.

commands.name: log
commands.description: Inspect commit history. Bound results with -n and disable pagers for unattended use.

args.name: -n
args.description: Maximum number of commits.

args.name: --oneline
args.description: One abbreviated hash and subject per commit.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: One commit per line with --oneline; the default format is a multi-line human-readable record.

name: GitHub CLI
purpose: Inspect GitHub pull requests from the command line

capabilities.name: gh
capabilities.description: Selected GitHub pull request inspection commands. Requires existing gh authentication. Partial community schema.

commands.name: pr list
commands.description: List pull requests in a repository.

args.name: --repo
args.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO form.

args.name: --json
args.description: Comma-separated fields, such as number,title,url,state.

capabilities.name: jq
capabilities.description: Transform and inspect JSON with jq. Partial community schema; jq uses a filter argument rather than subcommands.

capabilities.name: <filter> [file...]
capabilities.description: Apply a jq filter to JSON from files or stdin and write matching values to stdout.

args.name: --arg
args.description: Bind a named string variable; requires NAME VALUE.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A stream of JSON values, or raw strings when --raw-output is used.

name: ripgrep
purpose: Search file contents and list project files
coverage: Text search and file listing; excludes preprocessing and indexing

capabilities.name: rg
capabilities.description: Search file contents with ripgrep. Search mutation status is unknown because --pre runs a program for each searched file. File listing does not search files, so it is read-only. Partial community schema covering text search and file listing; preprocessing, indexing, and replacement options are excluded. Examples disable configuration.

capabilities.name: <pattern> [path...]
capabilities.description: Search a regular expression in files or stdin. Hidden and ignored files are skipped by default.

args.name: path
args.description: One or more files or directories; use - for stdin.

args.name: --fixed-strings
args.description: Match literal text instead of a regular expression.

args.name: --glob
args.description: Include matching paths; a leading ! excludes them. Repeatable.

args.name: --max-count
args.description: Stop after this many matching lines in each file.

args.name: --json
args.description: Emit newline-delimited JSON events.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Matching text, or JSON events with --json; not a JSON array.

capabilities.name: --files [path...]
capabilities.description: List searchable files without inspecting their contents.

args.name: path
args.description: One or more directories; defaults to the current directory.

args.name: --glob
args.description: Filter paths with a glob. Repeatable.

args.name: --hidden
args.description: Include hidden files and directories.

args.name: --null
args.description: Terminate paths with NUL instead of a newline.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: File paths separated by newlines, or NUL with --null.

name: fd
purpose: Find files and directories by name
coverage: File and directory discovery; excludes command execution

capabilities.name: fd
capabilities.description: Find filesystem entries by name. Partial community schema covering discovery only; command execution options are excluded. Some distributions install the executable as fdfind rather than fd.

capabilities.name: [pattern] [path...]
capabilities.description: Find matching names beneath the supplied directories. Defaults to the current directory and skips hidden and ignored entries.

args.name: pattern
args.description: Regular expression matched against entry names; omit to match all.

args.name: path
args.description: One or more directories to search.

args.name: --glob
args.description: Interpret the pattern as a glob.

args.name: --type
args.description: Filter files, directories, symlinks, executables, empty entries, sockets, or pipes.

args.name: --extension
args.description: Filter by extension without a leading dot. Repeatable.

args.name: --exclude
args.description: Exclude a glob. Repeatable.

args.name: --print0
args.description: Terminate results with NUL.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Matching paths separated by newlines, or NUL with --print0. Terminal output may contain colors.

name: curl
purpose: Fetch HTTP responses and inspect headers
coverage: HTTP response bodies and HEAD requests; excludes uploads and authentication options

capabilities.name: curl
capabilities.description: Transfer data over HTTP or HTTPS. Mutation status is unknown: --config can supply additional options, --request accepts arbitrary HTTP methods, and output options can write local files. Examples disable default configuration and bound request time and response size. Other protocols, uploads, and authentication options are excluded.

global_args.name: --disable
global_args.description: Skip the default curl configuration file. Must be the first argument.

global_args.name: --max-time
global_args.description: Limit the transfer duration in seconds.

global_args.name: --max-filesize
global_args.description: Refuse a response larger than this many bytes; curl exits 63 without transferring it.

global_args.name: --silent
global_args.description: Suppress the progress meter and errors; pair with --show-error to retain errors.

capabilities.name: <url>
capabilities.description: Fetch a response body. HTTP defaults to GET unless other options change the method.

args.name: --header
args.description: Add a request header in NAME: VALUE form. Repeatable.

args.name: --location
args.description: Follow redirects.

args.name: --fail
args.description: Fail on HTTP errors, normally suppressing the response body.

args.name: --write-out
args.description: Append transfer metadata using curl variables such as %{http_code}.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Response bytes, followed by --write-out text if requested. Content is not necessarily JSON.

capabilities.name: --head <url>
capabilities.description: Send an HTTP HEAD request and print response headers.

args.name: --location
args.description: Follow redirects; output can contain multiple header blocks.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: HTTP status lines and headers as text.

name: Docker
purpose: Inspect containers, logs, and local images
coverage: Container listing, inspection, logs, and image listing

capabilities.name: docker
capabilities.description: Inspect containers, logs, and local images through an existing Docker daemon connection. Partial community schema; container lifecycle, builds, exec, Compose, and registry writes are excluded.

commands.name: container ls
commands.description: List running containers, or include stopped containers with --all.

args.name: --last
args.description: Show the n most recently created containers, including stopped ones.

args.name: --filter
args.description: Filter with key=value conditions. Repeatable.

args.name: --format
args.description: Go template applied to each container.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; {{json .}} emits one JSON object per container, not an array.

commands.name: container inspect
commands.description: Read metadata for one or more containers.

args.name: container
args.description: One or more container names or IDs.

args.name: --format
args.description: Format each result with a Go template.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A JSON array of container metadata by default; --format changes the output.

commands.name: container logs
commands.description: Retrieve container logs. Availability depends on the logging driver; bound output with --tail or --since.

args.name: --tail
args.description: Number of trailing lines, or all.

args.name: --since
args.description: Timestamp or relative duration, such as 10m.

args.name: --follow
args.description: Keep streaming new logs until interrupted.

output_fields.name: stdout/stderr
output_fields.description: Container log streams; content depends on the application and TTY configuration.

commands.name: image ls
commands.description: List images stored by the connected Docker daemon.

args.name: repository[:tag]
args.description: Restrict results to a repository and optional tag.

args.name: --filter
args.description: Filter with key=value conditions. Repeatable.

args.name: --format
args.description: Go template applied to each image.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; {{json .}} emits one JSON object per image row, not an array.

name: npm
purpose: Inspect JavaScript dependencies and package metadata
coverage: Installed dependency listing and registry metadata

capabilities.name: npm
capabilities.description: Inspect installed dependencies and registry metadata. Mutation status is unknown because npm's configured cache and logs can be written. Installation, scripts, and publishing are excluded.

commands.name: ls
commands.description: Inspect installed dependency versions. Missing or invalid dependencies can produce a nonzero exit status.

args.name: package-spec
args.description: Optional package filter.

args.name: --depth
args.description: Maximum dependency depth.

args.name: --workspace
args.description: Workspace name or path; repeatable.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Dependency tree as text, or a JSON object with --json.

commands.name: view
commands.description: Read package metadata from the configured npm registry.

args.name: package-spec
args.description: Package name with an optional version or tag.

args.name: field
args.description: Optional metadata field, such as engines.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Selected metadata; --json emits JSON whose shape depends on the fields and versions requested.

name: uv
coverage: Installed package listing, metadata, and requirements output

capabilities.name: uv
capabilities.description: Inspect packages in an existing Python environment. Mutation status is unknown: interpreter discovery can download Python, and uv maintains a persistent cache. Project resolution, installation, and execution are excluded.

commands.name: pip list
commands.description: List installed packages.

args.name: --python
args.description: Python interpreter path or request.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; --format json emits an array of package records.

commands.name: pip show
commands.description: Inspect installed package metadata.

args.name: package
args.description: One or more package names.

args.name: --python
args.description: Python interpreter path or request.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Text metadata, optionally including installed file paths.

commands.name: pip freeze
commands.description: Print installed packages in requirements format.

args.name: --python
args.description: Python interpreter path or request.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Requirements text; this does not create a project lockfile.

name: kubectl
purpose: Inspect Kubernetes resources and container logs

capabilities.name: kubectl
capabilities.description: Inspect Kubernetes resources using an existing kubeconfig. Mutation status is unknown: inherited --profile writes --profile-output, and kubeconfig credential plugins can execute programs. Apply, delete, exec, and rollout changes are excluded.

global_args.name: --request-timeout
global_args.description: Request timeout as a duration, such as 30s.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read resources from the selected cluster.

args.name: resource
args.description: Resource type and optional name, such as pods or pods/app.

args.name: --selector
args.description: Label selector.

examples: kubectl --namespace default --request-timeout 30s get pod app --output json

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; JSON and YAML return a resource or a list object depending on the query.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Inspect resource details and related events.

args.name: resource
args.description: Resource type and optional name.

args.name: --selector
args.description: Label selector.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Human-readable resource details; not a stable machine-readable format.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Read logs from a pod or supported workload resource.

args.name: --container
args.description: Container name.

args.name: --tail
args.description: Number of trailing lines; use a positive bound.

args.name: --since
args.description: Relative duration, such as 10m.

args.name: --follow
args.description: Stream logs until interrupted.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Application log text. --follow keeps the command running.

name: Terraform
purpose: Inspect infrastructure state, plans, and outputs
coverage: Saved plan and state display, outputs, and resource addresses

capabilities.name: terraform
capabilities.description: Inspect Terraform state and saved plans in an initialized working directory. Mutation status is unknown because configured backends can make remote requests and the CLI checks HashiCorp Checkpoint. Init, plan, apply, and state edits are excluded.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Display current state or a saved state or plan file. JSON includes sensitive values in plaintext.

args.name: file
args.description: Optional saved state or plan path.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Human-readable state or plan by default; -json emits a structured object.

commands.name: output
commands.description: Read root module outputs from state. JSON and raw output reveal sensitive values.

args.name: name
args.description: Optional output name.

args.name: -raw
args.description: Print a named string, number, or boolean without JSON encoding.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: All outputs or a named value; -json returns JSON and -raw returns a scalar string.

commands.name: state list
commands.description: List resource addresses recorded in state.

args.name: address
args.description: Optional address filters; multiple accepted.

args.name: -id
args.description: Filter by resource ID.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: One resource address per line.

name: yq (Mike Farah)
coverage: YAML expression evaluation across individual or multiple documents; excludes file writes

capabilities.name: yq
capabilities.description: Query YAML with Mike Farah yq v4, not the Python jq wrapper of the same name. Partial community schema; in-place editing and split-file output are excluded.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluate an expression separately against each input document.

args.name: file
args.description: One or more files; use - for stdin.

args.name: --exit-status
args.description: Fail when there are no matches or the result is null or false.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: YAML by default, or JSON with --output-format json. Multiple documents can produce multiple values.

commands.name: eval-all
commands.description: Load all documents before evaluating one expression across them.

args.name: file
args.description: One or more files; use - for stdin.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: Expression result as YAML by default. All inputs are held in memory.
